items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 19:1
items.html: Malchut is so called when she is without the sweetening of the attribute of mercy, for ‘human breasts’ indicate the sweetened abundance in the attribute of mercy, by which Malchut was corrected in the second restriction. And ‘animal breasts’ indicate that she lacks the connection of the attribute of mercy that sweetens her. Therefore, those lower two breasts of Netzach and Hod of Atik, which are found below the Parsa of Atzilut, and which nurse the Partzufim by force of the first restriction — where Malchut is not yet sweetened there in the attribute of mercy — are called ‘animal breasts.’ This is the secret of their standing in the place of nakedness, meaning that the external forces have a hold in them, since they lack the sweetening of the attribute of mercy. (Inner Light, Item 643, Sub Header, “And They Are Called”)
